authorization.authorization_context: GRAPH6_CURRICULUM_002 attempt 003 - REPLACEMENT for attempt 002, which failed after 574.2 s in the FIRST learner's before-loss pass with KeyError because every learner was built over the frozen train+practice lessons while the varied condition trains on the varied curriculum. Fixed before this registration: each learner is built over its OWN condition's lessons with the explicit contract learner_factory(framework, own_tasks); a fail-closed guard LEARNER_INDEX_MISSING_OWN_CONDITION_RECORDS scores the learner's own records BEFORE any training; verify_checkpoint now takes learner_for(framework) so the reload verification predicts with the RELOADED module instead of the trained one; practice accuracy is measured on the frozen records for both conditions with each learner's own-curriculum accuracy reported separately; and a new test EXECUTES the rendered worker inner runner against stubs (251 graph tests pass). The pre-registered design is UNCHANGED: frozen candidate, encoder and tokenizer fitting set, CAS framing, operation:^6 scope; control = the existing 30 lessons, varied = the 30 new relationship lessons (where 'none' is offered in 7 FIND_SHARED_PART lessons - correct in 4, an incorrect distractor in 3, closing the choose-none shortcut); three PAIRED seeds 20260913/20260914/20260915 with matched initial weights verified by equal initial checkpoint identity, separate learner copies and separate optimizer states; a balanced round-robin schedule identical in both conditions; measurements at 64 and 256 updates per learner; six learners; 1536 total updates. Final panel: untouched, 30 pairwise non-isomorphic arrangements selected from a 92-arrangement pool, inside the documented teaching envelope and using only the 34 supported teaching words; 90 cases, one question per operation, reach labels 10/10/10; excluded by exact id AND label-invariant signature against the teaching dataset (seed 20260909), the examined panel (seed 20260920) and the varied curriculum; equal difficulty is NOT claimed. Pre-registered rules: P1 per seed varied-minus-control at 256 updates >= +0.10 with family-clustered 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0; P2 per seed varied at 256 >= 0.50 absolute; P3 repetition effects reported but never gating; verdict VARIED_CURRICULUM_BETTER iff at least 2 of 3 seeds satisfy P1 AND at least 2 satisfy P2, else VARIED_CURRICULUM_NOT_ESTABLISHED; uncertainty = 10,000-resample family-clustered percentile bootstrap (seed 20260926) plus exact McNemar; thresholds NOT lowered. Delivery: REAL checkpoint files (model state_dict, optimizer state, encoder projection and tokenizer vocabulary, step, condition, seed) at initial, 64 and 256 updates, reloaded into a fresh module in-job and verified by parameter identity and re-prediction, loaded under PyTorch's safe weights_only default (never disabled), then collected and sha256-verified BEFORE the bucket is deleted. ONE job, one new $7.00 reservation, zero automatic retries, verified cleanup, every learner and both checkpoints reported including regressions.
